harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the supplied ED25519 public key and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication. Configuration and SSH service health persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin with home directory and /bin/bash; locked password authentication for the account.
Installed the supplied key in /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with 0700 directory and 0600 file permissions plus the correct SELinux label.
Configured sshd to enable public-key authentication, disable password and keyboard-interactive authentication, and require AuthenticationMethods publickey.
Validated sshd configuration and confirmed TCP/22 advertises only publickey authentication.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed from fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34 to 36967113-b987-47f1-bdf9-8b2978df6060.
Verified the account, authorized key, SSH policy, listener, and service health after restart.

evidence.requirement: Configure opsadmin with the supplied public key
evidence.summary: Shows the opsadmin account, secure ownership and permissions, correct SELinux label, and the installed ED25519 key fingerprint SHA256:dzumj/cx0zCYHF+qGqYpYxim69qp3tvnujZ1d97UGls with the requested comment.

Shows successful sshd validation, effective AuthenticationMethods publickey, PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, active TCP/22 listeners, and live authentication probes advertising only publickey.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state and original boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID after recovery, running system state, active/enabled sshd, preserved account/key, effective key-only policy, and recovered TCP/22 listener.
